title: BJP Plan: Sachin pilot  to be next CM of Rajasthan | Capital TV
description: Infighting in congress continues in Rajasthan before Rajya Sabha Election. Sachin Pilot is going to break congress like Madhya Pradesh to become Chief Minister. Pilot will join BJP with 36 MLAs of Congress.  #SachinPilot #RajyaSabhaElections #RajeshPilot #Congress #PCC #राजेश_पायलट #SachinPilot  #CapitalTV #CapitalTVOnline   Follow us for regular updates  Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/capitaltvindia/  Twitter: https://twitter.com/capitaltvindia

asr.full_text: Welcome to the news of Namaskar. The Kamal is about to bloom in Rajasthan and these Kamal will feed the Sachin Pilod. Because the Congress is in a state of confusion in Rajasthan and Ashok Gahlot is in a state of confusion, the Bharatiya Janata Party has come up with a plan. And there is a riot between this grim confusion between Sachin Palit and Ashok Gahlot. Both are engaged in criticism of each other. So at that time Sachin Pilot said that there is no information that such an offer has come with the Indian Janata Patti. It is not possible. This is not possible. This is being made worthless. Even after this, Ashog Gehlot started to speak against Sachin Pilot. He said that we are the head of the government and the head of the government has more information. And yet 22 MLAs resigned from Congress. And then the Congress government fell there. Some of the situations are now coming to Rajasthan and the heroine of Operation Lotus who will be this time will be Sachin Pilot. Sachin Pilot will become Chief Minister and for this, the Bharatiya Janata Party has almost become an internal party. Bharatiya Janata Party has another leader there who is the Bharatiya Janata Party and who is most likely to be the chief minister has made Sachin Pilot even more attracted to him. And Basra Raj Indria has also indicated that Rajasthan politics may have been a big deal that has brought him into the politics of the Centre and that after this, the Pashinese have been able to get rid of the MLAs who are now in favour of him. Bharatiya Janata Party could have formed a government there only after the resignation of three or four MLAs, but Bharatiya Janata Party did not form a government there until it needed to rely on other MLAs but it was going to bring the same plan in Rajasthan itself because the Bharatiya Janata Party in Madhya Pradesh had resigned from the Congress MLAs after the resignation of the Congress MLA, which reduced the number of the members of the Legislative Assembly. They will come with them and they will know what is happening with them later but the current situation is that there are 13 MLAs who are not now Sachin Pilet who has been in touch with some leaders of Bharatiya Janata Patte for two or three months and therefore is working on his 36th draft with Ashok Gahlawat. So in such a situation, Jyotiradi Sindhi was kind of stuck on the same thing that was being talked about in the Rajsava seat and later in Kinder, which was to be a minister who would be the next cabinet extension of Modi government. In such a situation, because of a mantra, he could not leave the party, and the situation that is now being created is that when Sachin Pilots leave Congress, the Bharatiya Janata Party has more power. We have more power than that. The Bharatiya Janata Party will need 83 MLAs in the 164 member Rajasthan Legislative Assembly. And while Bharatiya Janata Party still has 72 MLAs and when the 13 MLAs come along with them, the number of MLAs will be 85. It will easily cross the majority figures when the Congress is in big split. But in Congress for a split there is talk of making Sachin Pilot Chief Minister. So that Kamal but his players in Rajasthan can make Sachin Pilot. And with it the different parties that have a MLA. The party was over and joined the Congress, but there was no party change to the party, no law was passed against him. Just as there are three MPs from the National Democratic Party and the Indian Janta. And Kamal will be in Rajasthan. The whole thing that was going on in Rajasthan was going on for the last two months but was waiting for the time when Congress is in a weak position and then Congress can be attacked. The candidate Congress has a clash between the two and at a time when the Congress broke up in Rajasthan, Rahul Gandhi had asked his close friend to send Ben Gopal from Rajasthan. And in a time when Congress is afraid that the Congress of Rajasthan is about to split, they have not expressed the possibility that they have not expressed the possibility that even Sachin Pilot and Ashok Gehlot would not agree.

The studio presentation and repeated Capital TV branding are consistent with a news segment, and the request to follow social-media links is ordinary audience engagement rather than financial participation or deception.
